caption: The drawing features a single wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, facing slightly to the right. The chair consists of a curved seat with horizontal wood grain, a slightly inclined backrest made up of five vertical slats, two horizontal supports, and two curved rockers at the base. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, with darker areas along the curved rockers and structural pieces, and lighter highlights on the seat and backrest, indicating the texture and natural variation in the wood. The background is a blank, off-white or light beige color, which contrasts with the brown tones of the chair. The composition is centered, with the chair isolated in the middle of the page and no other objects present. There is a small, neat signature with a date located near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Chair
